1: Aey Rasool! Jab aap ke deen ke liye Allah ki madad aa jaye, woh us ko izzat de, aur Makkah fatah ho jaye,
2: aur aap logon ko dekhein ke woh gurohon ki shakl mein Islam mein daakhil ho rahe hain,
3: to jaan lijiye ke yeh us kaam ke poora hone ki nishani hai jis ke liye aap ko bheja gaya tha. Pas apne Rubb ki tasbeeh kijiye us ki tareef ke sath, taake madad aur fatah ki niyamaton par us ka shukr ada ho, aur us se magfirat maangiye, kyunke beshak wohi bakhshne wala hai, jo apne bandon ki tauba qubool karta hai aur unhein maaf farmata hai.
